description: Trump pulled in $2.2 billion last year while a UAE royal bought half his crypto firm for $500 million days before his inauguration — after which the administration approved AI chip sales to the Emirates and proposed a $1.8B slush fund for insurrectionists.

faqs.answer: According to a 927-page OGE disclosure released June 30, 2026, Trump earned more than $2.2 billion from real estate, golf, crypto ventures, meme coins, branded merchandise, and legal settlements.
faqs.question: How much money did Trump make last year?

faqs.answer: Four days before his inauguration, associates of UAE national security adviser Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed bought a 49% stake in Trump's World Liberty Financial for $500 million. Warren, Murphy, and Schiff have called for investigations, noting the administration subsequently approved AI chip sales to the UAE and took 10+ UAE-benefiting actions.
faqs.question: What is the UAE crypto deal?

faqs.answer: A proposed DOJ 'anti-weaponization' fund of $1.776 billion that would have paid settlements to Trump allies including January 6 defendants. Raskin called it unconstitutional and illegal. The DOJ claimed to abandon it but court filings suggest otherwise.
faqs.question: What was the $1.8 billion slush fund?

leadParagraph: Sen. Mark Kelly called Trump's corruption 'unprecedented' on Meet the Press as a 927-page disclosure revealed the president earned $2.2 billion last year — including $500 million from a UAE-backed crypto deal followed by policy decisions benefiting the Emirates and a proposed $1.8 billion taxpayer slush fund for January 6 defendants.

mainImage.alt: President Donald J. Trump speaks with UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan during a bilateral meeting at Qasr al Watan (Palace of the Nation) on May 15, 2025, in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
mainImage.caption: Donald Trump at the White House as scrutiny mounts over a $500 million UAE investment in his family's cryptocurrency firm

methodology: Reported using Guardian, Breitbart, CNN, CNBC, Gizmodo, Sen. Murphy's office, Daily Beast, Atlantic, Time, House Judiciary Dems, and New Republic coverage. Financial data from 927-page OGE disclosure. UAE deal details from WSJ, CNN, and Warren staff report.
